svg.title: Three tools IBM adds to its support
svg.desc: Three tools IBM lists with its Technology Lifecycle Services. Call Home and Electronic Service Agent: helps strengthen infrastructure resiliency through AI and automation. Support Insights: a unified support experience across hybrid environments, with Risk Alerts, Case Metrics and Inventory Management. Support assistant: a conversational AI assistant, with help on invoicing, entitlements and credits.
